newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi sets up NZ debt programme.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi sets up NZ debt programme.

text.p: The Auckland branch of Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi (Australia) Ltd has established a NZ$200 million medium-term note programme and a NZ$200 million Commercial Paper programme in the New Zealand market, the programme's arranger, Bank of New Zealand, said on Wednesday.
Standard & Poor's has assigned an A1 rating to the CP notes and an A-plus rating to the medium-term notes.
The dealer group for both programmes consists of ANZ Bank (NZ), Bank of New Zealand, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi (Australia) Ltd, the National Bank of NZ, and Westpac Banking Corp.
Last month, the Australian branch of Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, a unit of Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, was granted bank registration in New Zealand.
